info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Mortgage Loans Documents-v5-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Document Retrieval API provides users with an efficient way to access and review documents associated with mortgage loans. This API enables consumers, such as lenders and financial institutions, to fetch relevant documentation needed for processing loans. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can easily integrate document retrieval functionalities into their applications, streamlining the loan management process. Typical use cases include verifying borrower documentation, assessing loan eligibility, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

get.description: Fetch the documents associated with loans, providing details about the application and necessary documentation for processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve loan documents. Ensure that the necessary parameters and filters, if required, are included to get the appropriate loan documents.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of loan documents.
